newsitem.title: USA: MRV Communications sees big rise in Q1 revs.
newsitem.headline: MRV Communications sees big rise in Q1 revs.

text.p: MRV Communications said it expects to report an increase in revenue "in excess of 100 percent" for its first quarter, compared with the quarter a year ago.
It made the forecast as it said its business "continues to be robust across all product lines." It said it expects to issue results for the quarter on April 28.
For the first quarter of 1996, the company reported revenues of $15.5 million and net income of $1.9 million, or $0.09 a share.
Noam Lotan, president and chief executive officer, said that the company has not experience the sales slowdown in Japan and Europe encountered by other vendors.
He said that MRV's growth is led by strong shipments of its MegaSwitch II. The company is also experiencing growth in its fiber optic component product lines, he said.
